notes.title: Hopping Up For It: A new "Only Up" style game from the developer of 16 Bit Arena
notes.content:
Hopping Up For It is a new "Only Up" / "Getting Over It" / "Jump King" style game from the developer of 16 Bit Arena!  You can find it at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/502050/Hopping_Up_for_It/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/502050/Hopping_Up_for_It/[/url]
Check it out! :)
[previewyoutube=vi5e9OCXq-w;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Closing of 16 Bit Arena
notes.content: 16 Bit Arena, an always-free game but one which relies on (and has long since lacked) active users, has removed the installation capability for new users and will be removing all else sometime after 90 days have passed.  Thank you for your understanding and past plays of 16 Bit Arena!

notes.title: The Mind Hero now on Steam Greenlight
notes.content: By the same main developer as 16 Bit Arena, The Mind Hero is now on [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=702872998]Steam Greenlight[/url]. This unique single-player comic-style visual novel will teach actual psychology subtly within the story, and allow you to enter the minds of eight individuals to help them.  The trailer as well as the intro (interactive from your PC's browser) are both available on themindhero.com

notes.title: The Mind Hero now in development
notes.content:
By the same main developer as 16 Bit Arena, The Mind Hero is now being developed. It is to be a single-player puzzle/platformer/dating sim created as a PC game and an app, and here's the kicker: as you venture through the minds of the girls, you're subtly learning actual psychological concepts that can be useful in real life. 
Please support on the official site: [url=http://www.themindhero.com]www.themindhero.com[/url]

notes.title: Boss battles!
notes.content: The Champion has arrived!  If you've collected 16 Cards & Gems, you can be a Champion for a Boss battle against multiple characters.  Bring forth lions (which can attack and protect you, and you can boost and revive them), cut your enemies to shreds with your double swords, blast them with magic, auto-revive (at a cost) and more!  See the Arena guide for full details.

notes.title: Recent updates
notes.content:
- Rankings have begun (the Plaque of Fame is also updated to the screenshots shown on this page)
- You can use cards repeatedly during battle, transforming as many times as you'd like, allowing you to adapt to new situations
- You can give your arrow directly to an ally (with the Switch button)
- Gems give you a small starting boost (i.e. DEF +1) depending on the gem
- You can use the random stat boost button on yourself or an ally, spending your turn
- Removal of the constant "Charge +4" ability has increased tactical ability usefuless (i.e. Warrior's Cover and Healer's -DEF/MDEF/Evade) substantially
- Ability tweaks, such as Nima being able to select which card she transforms her target into, and Slime absorption still letting you get ranked
- Other gameplay tweaks, such a full elemental change when you transform, and being able to use Resist every time the enemy hurts you
- Damage tweaks
- Lots of bugs fixes, and if the game does freeze, you'll see it auto-unfreeze a few moments later
- Upcoming update will include a new, bossmode-only Armor character!
